exposure: morselized absorbable collagen sponge recombinant human bone morphogenetic protein-2 (rhBMP2) injected at the fusion site
cohort: Sixteen male 1-year-old rabbits undergoing posterolateral spinal fusion with iliac crest bone graft and given nicotine to impair fusion.
finding: Injectable morselized absorbable collagen sponge/rhBMP-2 delivered 4 weeks post-surgery created twice as much bone within a nicotine-impaired rabbit spine fusion model compared to controls.
